description: Read what your workspace's own records say about its pricing, as findings, most urgent first: learned estimates ready while learned pricing is off, estimates that cannot be used yet and exactly what each needs, whether enough quotes have a reported outcome, how often your guardrails held prices back, and approvals waiting or about to expire. Each finding states its numbers and names the call that would act on it; nothing is changed. Free, and computed without an AI model. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_pricing_analysis
